explanation: Beckoning someone with a curled index finger (palm up) is considered rude and even aggressive in Singapore, similar to Japan, since the gesture is associated with calling animals or, in some tellings, has a connotation linked to death. A polite alternative is to wave with the palm facing down.
local_tip: To call someone over, wave with your whole hand, palm facing down, rather than curling a single finger toward yourself.

also_check.note: The same curled-finger beckoning gesture is considered rude and is associated with calling animals rather than people.
Beckoning with a curled finger can be seen as a serious insult and is even linked to past legal trouble when used toward police.
The gesture is used casually among friends but can come across as arrogant or demanding in formal settings.
